additional_context: A same-day Zulip implementers thread shows the reporter identifying the bad Java @ResourceDef profile URL, discussing it as a build bug, and filing GF19293 after Grahame Grieve requested a tracker. Current source no longer contains implementations/java Java model resources or JavaResourceGenerator.java; later cleanup, including 5ffadd84f0955f35a3d73a16accd671c0d564d56, removed the remaining implementations/java files. Confluence searches found no directly relevant meeting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source searches found no bad http://hl7.org/fhir/Profile/[Resource] canonical URLs and no Java implementation source surface to correct in this checkout.
